note: Frozen typed, parameterized components (FREEZE.md). A template's fixed text is exact bytes; ${X} is a hole. Expansion replaces each hole with its operand's decoded bytes; a hole named twice repeats the same bytes and is charged once. Hole types: id = exactly one selection, which must be an identifier-shaped literal entry (no END); pure = one side-effect-free expression, then END; expr = one expression, then END; stmts = zero or more complete statements of one block, then END. Guards are checked on the AST before a match is admitted (fail closed). Contracts state the component's meaning; decoding is byte-exact to a qualified source, so they type the vocabulary and do not replace qualification.

hole_types.id: Identifier node; operand is one literal selection matching ^[A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$]*$; no END
hole_types.pure: one Expression node (parentheses preserved) with no call, new, assignment, update, delete, await or yield; operand codes then END
hole_types.expr: one Expression node (parentheses preserved); operand codes then END
hole_types.stmts: a contiguous run of zero or more statements inside one block or program body; operand codes then END

components.name: map increment
guards: M is declared in the program with initializer new Map(...)
K is pure (it is evaluated twice)
components.aliasing: M is not reachable from K
components.numeric: M[K] is absent or a safe integer; result M[K] <= 2^53-1

components.name: map add
components.inputs: M: Map; K: key; D: number
components.effects: writes M[K]; evaluates D once after K
components.numeric: M[K]+D within the problem's numeric domain

components.name: map decrement
components.numeric: M[K] is a safe integer; may reach 0 or below

components.name: map get or zero
guards: M is declared with new Map(...)
the match is a complete LogicalExpression node

components.name: dense increment
guards: the match is a complete ExpressionStatement
components.inputs: C: array of numbers; K: integer index
components.numeric: C[K] is a number; index in range by the source's qualification

components.name: count table
guards: the match is a complete VariableDeclaration
components.effects: declares a fresh array of N zeros

components.name: count lowercase letters
components.inputs: A: iterable of single lowercase letters a-z
components.effects: declares C; increments C once per element

components.name: drain by pop
components.inputs: Q: array used as a stack
components.effects: removes the last element each iteration; B may push

components.name: drain by shift
components.inputs: Q: array used as a FIFO queue
components.effects: removes the first element each iteration

components.name: guarded drain
components.effects: C is evaluated only when Q is non-empty

components.name: head-index queue
components.inputs: Q: array used as a FIFO queue without removal
components.effects: reads each element once in order; B may push

components.name: level loop
components.effects: replaces Q by the next level W after each pass

components.name: push
components.aliasing: E may alias other state, as in the source

components.name: visit once (array)
components.inputs: S: boolean array; V: node index
components.aliasing: S is not reachable from V
components.numeric: V in range by the source's qualification

components.name: visit once (set)
guards: S is declared with new Set(...)

components.name: grid directions (N,E,S,W)
components.aliasing: X is a fresh pair each iteration

components.name: undirected edge build
components.inputs: E: list of [u,v] pairs with 0-based nodes; G: adjacency lists

components.name: null base case
components.effects: returns E for the empty tree

components.name: max of children
components.inputs: A: tree node; F: fold returning a number

components.name: fold children
components.effects: folds left then right into fresh L and R

components.name: push present children
components.effects: appends present children left then right

components.name: list walk (unary fold)
components.effects: visits each node once, then advances
components.aliasing: B must not reassign P (checked: no assignment to P in B)
